title: Rollers footer
description: A charcoal footer with a faint sawtooth texture: a big orange mark over a bold white wordmark, a spaced uppercase sign-off on the right with every other word in orange, then hairline-ruled rows of link columns and depot addresses under orange uppercase headings, and the legal line. Links turn orange on hover; the rules draw in.
notes: dark in both modes: it uses the theme's .dark palette on itself
